calculation.description: Ranks assets with unusually weak or strong 45-session performance relative to trailing 120-session volatility. Positive values indicate underperformance and are expected to mean-revert over the forward 10-session horizon. The complete signal is shifted one session before validation or use.

validation.regime_notes: Validated across the full synthetic 2020-2034 history and multiple market regimes. The cross-section has 15 tradable assets; dates with at least 8 valid instruments were retained. Small-N IC uncertainty is interpreted conservatively.
